title: From Hacks to Bioweapons, Claude Misuse Is Now Everywhere
summary: Meta failed to catch roughly 350 AI child abuse ads , according to new research this week, including some that included images of real kids. Cybercriminal group ShinyHunters used Claude in practically every stage of its hacking and extortion campaigns.
